title: Luanda march demanding the removal of presidential chief of staff Edeltrudes Costa
participants_original: About one hundred people, as reported by Euronews/LUSA.
threshold_50_evidence: The contemporaneous report estimates about one hundred marchers, above the 50-person threshold; it is approximate, so numeric bounds are not assigned.

start_date.summary: Euronews/LUSA reports the march took place on Saturday 3 October 2020.

end_date.summary: The article describes a single-day march but gives no explicit ending time; same-day end is provisional.

location.summary: The march began at Largo das Heroínas and stopped at Mutamba, Luanda.

scope.summary: One local Luanda march is described.

organizer.summary: The article mentions organizers collecting signatures but does not identify an organization; unknown.

demands.summary: Marchers demanded the President dismiss his chief of staff over alleged public-contract corruption.

participants_original.summary: Source says about one hundred people; approximate wording retained.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The reported approximate attendance is around twice the minimum threshold.

protester_violence.summary: No evidence about protester violence is reported; unknown.

state_response.summary: A police cordon stopped the march approaching the presidential area; the listed response categories are otherwise unknown.

notes: The removal demand concerned a presidential chief of staff, not a named elected politician. The available code is political_behavior_process; review the category mapping against the missing original codebook. Allegations about contracts are not treated as adjudicated facts.
open_questions: Confirm whether removal_of_politician is more appropriate than political_behavior_process under the original manual.
Verify any later route, end time or police action beyond the cordon.

title: 24 October protests over living conditions and municipal elections
scope: multi-province reports; whether the two locations were one coordinated national action remains unresolved
organizer: Civil-society movements; Novo Jornal identifies the Revolutionary Movement and Movement for Citizenship and reports UNITA support in Luanda.
participants_original: Radio Angola reports organizer/participant claims of more than 300 detentions; Amnesty reports 103 protesters and passersby arrested; an Esquerda search excerpt relays an approximately 2,000-person estimate attributed to Novo Jornal. These are not interchangeable attendance counts.
threshold_50_evidence: Pending: accessible body reports establish gatherings and arrests but do not give an attendance total. The approximately 2,000 estimate is search-result-only, and arrest counts include passersby; threshold not yet established.

start_date.summary: Amnesty, Radio Angola and RNA date the protests to 24 October 2020.

location.summary: Amnesty reports protests in Luanda and Huambo; Radio Angola and RNA describe the Luanda action.

scope.summary: The reports use plural/multi-location descriptions and identify common living-condition and municipal-election demands, but do not establish how locations were organized; grouping remains open.

organizer.summary: Radio Angola attributes the call to civil society with opposition-party support; Novo Jornal identifies the Revolutionary Movement and Movement for Citizenship and says UNITA supported the Luanda plan.

demands.summary: Reports describe high living costs/precarious conditions, jobs or unemployment, and holding municipal elections; the first two are not equally detailed in each source.

participants_original.summary: Available reports give incompatible arrest and crowd figures; arrest totals are not attendance. The roughly 2,000 estimate is a search snippet attributed to Novo Jornal.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No opened article supplies an attendance count. Arrest counts include nonparticipants; search-only crowd estimate requires body verification.

protester_violence.summary: Radio Angola and state broadcaster RNA report burning tires/property damage; Esquerda and News24 snippets also report vandalism. Some claims remain snippet-only.

state_response.summary: Reports document arrests, police beatings/force, barricades and tear gas. Radio Angola reports organizer claims of firearm shots; no independently established event death is coded.

deaths_and_shootings.summary: Radio Angola attributes a death and police gunfire to organizers; Amnesty's October account does not confirm a protester death; another search snippet reports organizer claims of two deaths. Death attribution remains unresolved.

notes: Actual protests are corroborated, but attendance, scale across provinces, and alleged deaths remain unsettled. The October 24 march followed new public-gathering restrictions and the postponement of local elections; no demand is inferred from police criticism alone.
open_questions: Find an opened, independent contemporaneous attendance estimate and verify whether 50 or more gathered at any location.
Establish whether Luanda and Huambo actions belonged to one organized national event or distinct local events.
Resolve conflicting detention totals and alleged protester deaths; retain killings=unknown until state responsibility is documented.

title: Gathering outside Luanda Provincial Court calling for release of 24 October detainees
organizer: Families, friends and colleagues of detained protesters (search-result description only)
participants_original: Several dozen young people, according to the search-result excerpt; body unavailable.
threshold_50_evidence: Unknown; the search excerpt says several dozen, which does not establish at least 50.

start_date.summary: Search-result excerpt dates the courthouse gathering to Monday 26 October 2020.

location.summary: Title and snippet place it outside Luanda Provincial Court.

scope.summary: A local gathering outside the provincial court is described.

organizer.summary: Snippet names families, friends and colleagues of detained people; no formal organizer identified.

demands.summary: Snippet says participants called for release of people detained during the previous Saturday march.

participants_original.summary: Search excerpt says several dozen youths; body was blocked and attendance wording is not precise.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The available excerpt does not establish a crowd of 50 or more; body returned HTTP 403.

protester_violence.summary: No information in search excerpt; unknown.

state_response.summary: No response by police at the courthouse gathering is established in the excerpt; unknown.

notes: Search-result-only candidate; no body read after an observed HTTP 403. The gathering is distinct in date and immediate demand from the 24 October march.
open_questions: Verify event occurrence, exact crowd size, participants, response and whether 50 or more assembled from another permitted source.
